text:
Emma Zhao: PR #18210 (feature/cached-prefix) is ready for final review — CI mostly green but mac-e2e is intermittently failing. We need to land before the deploy blackout Thu 00:00 ET, otherwise next slot is Monday. Ping @raj @liam for infra/perf signoff. I retriggered the mac job once.
Raj Patel: Looking now. If mac flakes again can we bypass it for the landing? It touches runtime scheduling so I'm cautious.
Liam O'Connor: I'd rather not skip mac. Rerun the job, I'll sanity-check perf traces. If the perf numbers are within delta I'll sign off.
Sophia Martinez: I can review the changelist in ~30m. Emma — did you rebase against main? I saw a minor Dockerfile conflict earlier.
Emma Zhao: Rebased onto main and force-pushed with `git push --force-with-lease`. CI started: <https://ci.internal/4975/build/102> — mac job still failing on the login flow flake.
ci-bot: mac-e2e failed (run #102) — flaky assertion in `auth.test.ts:login`. Rerun queued by @Emma Zhao.
Raj Patel: Reran mac once. If it fails twice we should consider holding and doing a controlled canary rather than full ship.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed. If mac fails again, hold. Also can we prepare a quick revert patch for the scheduling tweak so rollback is <5m?
Sophia Martinez: I'll add rollback steps to the PR body and include a canary env flag `FEATURE_CACHE_PREFIX=off` in the deploy job so we can toggle without a code rollback. Adding checklist now. :white_check_mark:
Emma Zhao: Mac passed on the rerun — all green. Requesting final approvals. @raj are the perf traces okay? @liam please give thumbs if you can. :eyes:
Liam O'Connor: Spot-checked traces, latency and p95 stable on canary traces. Approving now. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: Approved. I'll keep an eye on infra metrics post-deploy and take immediate action if the mac regression surfaces. :ok_hand:
Emma Zhao: Landing now. I'll watch rollout and escalate if anything odd. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
